status: sealed before new runs; new physical benchmark, not original periodic dynamic plant
initialization: Six independent standard normal draws from seed, normalized. K0 starts with normalized first two entries. No rejection or true-field information. x0 uniform over one phase cycle, drawn afterwards.
learner: Every one of six harmonic field weights independently adaptive. W=kron([1,cos(phase),sin(phase)],observed_velocity), H=[1,cos(phase),sin(phase)]@C.reshape(3,2). The learner receives phase and observed xdot, noisy ydot only, never true partial or residual structure.
law: Rdot=W W^T-R/memory; Cdot=-gain*(R C-(C^T R C)*C), norm(C)=1. Evolving analytic R(s), DOP853 linear normalization each held-sample interval.
readout: Frozen post-training H, independent supplied x/xdot episode, ydot_hat=-Hx*xdot/Hy, integrated from one measured initial y. No later y or ydot assimilation. Guard failure yields invalid query, no fallback.
comparators: K0 adaptive direct two-entry field on identical observed velocity stream; frozen initial K1 field on same heldout episode. Invalid comparator queries retained.
criteria_scope: Predetermined numerical evidence criteria, not theorem hypotheses or significance tests. Report every seed whether passing or failing; no heldout tuning.
supplied_assumptions: Known harmonic order K1 and coordinate phase (not separately manipulated physical input); exact x and xdot sensors; noisy ydot sensor. All representation weights independent; no unknown-frequency discovery.
scope: Direct rate-field representation and independent prediction in monotone graph geometry; neither original periodic-plant control nor high-dimensional integrability or strict identification under noise. Physical rowspace recovery evaluated after learning. Actual supplied x and xdot scales reported separately from fast output ydot.
